info.title: Pacta API, by Fractal Neurons

x-service.name: Pacta, by Fractal Neurons
x-service.description: Block-pinned EVM smart-contract control-plane, Gnosis Safe quorum, timelock delay, and calldata verification on Ethereum and Base.

info.x-guidance: Agents: the discovery, lookup, preflight and control-plane routes are free (no key, no wallet). /v1/x402/verdict, /v1/x402/dossier and /v1/x402/wallet-exposure (and the MCP tools pacta_verdict, pacta_dossier and pacta_scan_wallet_exposure): Free: 100 calls per caller per UTC day (no key, no payment); above 100/day, x402 payment ($0.02 / $0.05 USDC on Base) applies. The other /v1/x402/* routes (calldata-sim $0.25, deep-scan $9.00) are always paid with x402 (USDC on Base, exact scheme): call without a payment header to get the 402 requirements (JSON body + PAYMENT-REQUIRED header), then repeat the same POST with X-PAYMENT (x402 v1) or PAYMENT-SIGNATURE (x402 v2). Nothing is settled unless the product was produced; every settlement is re-checked on Base before the result is returned. Free tier: /v1/check/preflight and the MCP pacta_check_preflight tool share 50 free calls per caller per UTC day (X-Meter-Limit / X-Meter-Remaining / X-Meter-Reset), then $0.01 a call over the same x402 flow (never a dead-end 429). Humans can pay a fixed-price order in USDC on Base and unlock it at /v1/orders/verify.
info.description: Pacta by Fractal Neurons: read-only, block-pinned EVM control-plane checks for agents (Ethereum, Base), plus one opt-in write route (POST /v1/requests: coverage / feature requests). Pricing mode: freemium_x402 (scans free, no key; /v1/x402/verdict, /v1/x402/dossier and /v1/x402/wallet-exposure: Free: 100 calls per caller per UTC day (no key, no payment); above 100/day, x402 payment ($0.02 / $0.05 USDC on Base) applies. /v1/x402/calldata-sim ($0.25) and /v1/x402/deep-scan ($9.00) always charge USDC on Base to 0x4348DF1BEFAffcbA248B5118B1b782B1B2bdEd14; preflight: 50 and /v1/check/wallet-exposure: 100 free calls per caller per UTC day, then $0.01).

get.summary: Free protocol / token lookup (in memory; an unknown 0x address adds who_controls; free in every pricing mode)
get.description: Resolve a protocol or token name, symbol, slug or 0x address to Pacta's verified record: canonical slug and URL, checksummed primary contract and controller, classification with its evidence basis (eas_attested vs rpc_observed, documentationComparison not_assessed), and preflightArgs {chain, address} ready for /v1/check/preflight. Unknown parameters are rejected (400 invalid_input). A 0x address (or ethereum: / base: + address) that matches nothing is answered with who_controls, the /v1/check read (chain filter or prefix: that chain; none: Ethereum and Base, the chain with code first, who_controls_other_chains when both have code); it uses 1 of the 100 free daily who-controls calls, and a refused or unread read is an inline {error, detail} (the lookup stays 200, no-store).

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Name, token symbol, slug or 0x address (<= 80 chars; empty or * lists the catalog). Alias: query.

parameters.name: caller_agent
parameters.description: Optional identifier of the calling AI agent, IDE, or framework (e.g. 'claude-code', 'cursor', 'windsurf', 'coinbase-agentkit', 'elizaos', 'langchain', 'chatgpt', 'gemini', 'openclaw', 'custom-agent'). Omitted or invalid values never block a call (inferred from known client headers or 'unspecified'). Lowercase slug only; never include personal names, emails, or secrets. Optional.

parameters.description: Optional: high-level role category of the requester or system running this check (closed enum; no personal data). Optional.

parameters.name: caller_purpose
parameters.description: Optional: operational workflow context for this pre-execution check (closed enum). Optional.

citationFooter.description: Present when a protocol matched: the first protocol result's 2-line text (record page with its Base Mainnet EAS UID, or 'RPC-observed baseline; Base Mainnet EAS: not_attested'; then the issuer paths: the free doc-update queue or re-verification by arrangement pre-filled for the protocol, the protocol overview and pacta@dri.network; payment never alters a classification). Every protocol result carries its own citationFooter; MCP also returns it as a second text content block.

400.description: invalid_input (overlong query, bad chain / kind / limit, unknown parameter)

get.summary: Who controls this contract / token (free; two RPC providers, block-pinned)
get.description: who controls this contract / token: owner, admin, upgradeable proxy, timelock, multisig, can mint, can pause; rug check, token safety. Block-pinned chain facts on Ethereum and Base confirmed by two independent RPC providers, with Foundry cast commands; never guesses or rates. Free: 100 calls per caller per UTC day (no key, no payment). Free: 100 calls per caller per UTC day (no key, no payment), in every pricing mode; at most 15 per caller per minute. A 400 or 502 never uses a call. The same answer as the MCP tool pacta_who_controls_contract.

upgradeable.description: true: a standard proxy slot (EIP-1967 implementation / beacon, EIP-1822, ZeppelinOS) or comptrollerImplementation() holds an address; false only without contract code (none / 7702); null otherwise (custom upgrade logic not ruled out, or a slot could not be read)

standardProxyDetected.description: false only when all 6 standard proxy / admin / beacon slots and comptrollerImplementation() read cleanly as empty

upgradeDelaySeconds.description: the delay of a verified timelock that is the standard upgrade admin (or that admin's owner()); null otherwise

canMint.description: false only without contract code; null on contracts (static bytecode and getter reads alone do not prove or rule out a mint path)

canPause.description: true when paused() returns true; false only without contract code; null otherwise

alsoChecked.description: getters read on this contract that it does not expose

400.description: bad_request (missing, repeated or unknown parameter; chain not ethereum / base; address not 0x + 40 hex); never uses a call

429.description: daily_limit_reached (100 per caller per UTC day) or rate_limited (15 per minute); Retry-After

502.description: upstream_unavailable: the two RPC providers gave no agreed block, or the contract code could not be read; never uses a call

get.summary: Control-plane status badge (SVG) of a published protocol; also HEAD
get.description: Six tiers: Aligned · Base EAS (every record an EAS-attested aligned baseline), Parameter Delta (EAS-attested, documentation differs), RPC-Observed (RPC-pinned only; documentation not assessed), Unresolved · Unverified Scope and Docs Updated · Pending Re-Read (neutral: a documented breach is not established), Changed Recently · Re-Check Pending (observed within 48h of an on-chain change; due for a fresh re-read once the 72h window elapses). 5-minute cache, CORS *.

get.summary: Pacta findings ready to post on X (pacta.x_feed.v1); also HEAD
get.description: One item per published protocol (adverse_delta, recent_change, docs_updated, unresolved_scope, protective_delta, aligned_baseline, rpc_observed) plus active radar timelock operations (radar_timelock), in posting priority order. mainPostText (<= 270 chars) has no links or bare domains; replyPostText carries the receipt page and the Base EAS attestation. feedId is stable. Static data, free, 5-minute cache, CORS *.

schema.description: Comma list of: adverse_delta, protective_delta, radar_timelock, aligned_baseline, rpc_observed, recent_change, docs_updated, unresolved_scope

400.description: invalid_input (unknown kind, bad slug or limit, unknown or repeated parameter)

post.summary: Opt-in coverage / feature request (free in every pricing mode; 5 per hour per caller)
post.description: Queue a coverage or feature request (same arguments as the pacta_submit_request MCP tool). post.summary: Verify a Base USDC payment for a self-serve order and unlock it
post.description: Send USDC on Base to 0x4348DF1BEFAffcbA248B5118B1b782B1B2bdEd14, then POST the tx hash. Two independent Base RPC operators must return the receipt (status 0x1, a valid tx sender, the same block, depth >= 1) with canonical USDC Transfer logs to the treasury summing to at least the SKU price (fail closed). A tx unlocks one order (same body again = the same receipt; a different body = 409 tx_already_used). wallet-report-9 is the only SKU sold here: it returns the live wallet & Safe exposure report and its SHA-256 digest in the response; any other sku is refused (HTTP 400). webhook_or_contact is stored privately and never returned by any route.
